verdict.rationale: CockroachDB speaks the PostgreSQL wire protocol, so developers can build against it with any existing PostgreSQL client driver. A community comment corroborates reusing battle-tested Postgres clients, and the Cloud quickstart provides sample code for first queries. However, nothing in the pack shows first-party, CockroachDB-branded SDKs, and no OpenAPI spec was found for generating API clients. Missing for 10: evidence of official CockroachDB SDKs/client libraries per language, an official Cloud management API SDK or OpenAPI spec, SDK reference docs.
